name: Terrace Path head
purpose: The top of 706 steps: you come off the Terrace Path onto the crater lip, catch your breath at a carved summit stone, and see the caldera's steam and the cable station glow ahead.

portals.note: Top of the Terrace Path (plan point 0).

hero.why: A tall summit toro beside the carved summit stone: the reward for the climb and the natural pause, the brightest point on the path head, with the caldera steam rising behind it as you face east.
hero.outside_reason: Stands on the rock lip just beyond the walk band (the band is the deck; the lip is part of the same rim).

anchored.why: Marks the Terrace Path head; seen from the flights below as the last light.
anchored.outside_ok: Stands on the rock lip just beyond the walk band (the band is the deck; the lip is part of the same rim).

anchored.why: Rough basalt stele, gilt 火山湯 頂 +120 m, lit by the summit toro.
anchored.outside_ok: Stands on the rock lip just beyond the walk band (the band is the deck; the lip is part of the same rim).

sightlines.see: The stele and its toro 18 m ahead; behind them the caldera steam glowing teal and the cable station's warm windows.
Back down the flank: the Terrace Path's lantern zigzag and the cascade pools far below.

concept.match: Plan 30's Terrace Path head (D3): hinoki walk with lanterns dropping away down the west flank toward the cascade pools, cloud sea beyond.

dressing.why: Rock groups at the toro and stele and at both portals, on the crater-side lip.
dressing.outside_ok: Stands on the rock lip just beyond the walk band (the band is the deck; the lip is part of the same rim).

dressing.why: Hinoki deck over the rock at the path head (the rim walk's boardwalk starts here); the toro, stele and posts stand on it.

mood.palette: amber toro, teal steam glow, cold cloud sea

waivers.reason: The boardwalk is one continuous plank deck laid in 2 m pieces; regular spacing is the point, not a placement grid.
